newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SSAB shares jump after Q1 report.
newsitem.headline: SSAB shares jump after Q1 report.

text.p: Shares in Swedish steel group SSAB jumped after the company released its first quarter earnings and said it would be able to raise prices in local currencies.
At 1015 GMT, the share was up five percent, or seven crowns, at 139, while the exchange's general index rose 0.36 percent to 2,618.15.
"There were some worries that the profit would be lower than previously expected and it is positive that the company says it will be able to raise prices," a dealer said.
SSAB said its first quarter profit fell 44 percent to 470 million crowns, right on target according to a Reuter poll of analysts ahead of the report.
